newsitem.title: USA: Synetic files for $115 mln debentures.
newsitem.headline: Synetic files for $115 mln debentures.

text.p: Synetic Inc said Tuesday it filed a registration with Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to $115 million in convertible subordinated debentures.
Of the total, $15 million may be issued upon exercise of the underwriters over-allotment option, according to the filing.
The debentures mature Feb 15, 2007, and will be convertible any time before that unless previously redeemed or repurchased into common shares.
The offering will be made through Merrill Lynch & Co.
Proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes which may include acquitisions, the company stated in the filing.
Synetic, based in Elmwood Park, N.J., is in plastics technologies and health-care communications.
